name: Track Red Black Multi-Position Bench Small With High-Quality Materials for Workout – Black
description:
Track Red & Black Multi-Position Bench

Take your home workouts to the next level with the Track Multi-Position Bench, designed for durability, comfort, and versatility. Whether you’re strength training, doing core exercises, or full-body workouts, this bench adapts to your needs.

Key Features

Adjustable Design: Multiple backrest positions (incline, flat, decline) for a wide range of exercises including chest press, shoulder press, sit-ups, and more.

Premium Build: Made with high-quality steel frame for stability and long-lasting use.

Comfortable Padding: Thick, high-density foam cushioning covered with durable red & black PU leather for maximum comfort during workouts.

Compact & Space-Saving: Lightweight and easy to move, perfect for home gyms with limited space.

Versatile Use: Suitable for dumbbell and barbell exercises, ab training, and bodyweight workouts.

Specifications

Frame: Powder-coated steel

Color: Black with red edges

Seat & Backrest: Padded with high-density foam
